name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.live.SpeechVoiceLiveVideoH5Activity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user opens a web-based live-shopping video ad. It shows the video page with comments, product phrases, and goods links.
disableEffect: The interactive live-video ad and its product links will no longer open.
